verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents load balancing that distributes requests across multiple LLM models, and it can enforce rate limits through its AI Rate Limiting Advanced plugin, so it covers the throttling and traffic-spreading parts of the story. However, the evidence never says traffic can be spread across multiple API keys for the same provider, and it never mentions queuing requests. The rate-limiting evidence is only a plugin title plus a passing mention. Missing for 10: explicit spreading of traffic across multiple provider keys, request queuing behavior, detailed rate-limiting docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can smooth provider rate limits by spreading traffic across keys and queuing or throttling requests

citations.quote: AI Gateway provides load balancing capabilities to distribute requests across multiple LLM models.
